subject: Mutual roadmap kickoff: Evergreen Health evaluation scope & owners
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@evergreenhealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual roadmap kickoff: Evergreen Health evaluation scope & owners

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to put a short mutual roadmap (MAP) in place to make the 45–60 day evaluation as frictionless as possible and to align on success criteria, owners, and key dates. I’ve attached a brief MAP template and a sample evaluation checklist to get us started (see attachments).

High-level proposal:
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference for clinical documentation summarization at Evergreen pilot sites
- Success criteria: 85% macro-averaged F1 on benchmark prompt set + <300ms 95th percentile generation latency for 2k tokens
- Proposed evaluation window: 60 days (flexible to accelerate)
- Key milestones: kickoff -> data ingestion test -> pilot run (15 days) -> interim review -> final evaluation

Requests from your side:
1) Champion and technical owners (names + emails)
2) Any regulatory/procurement constraints (SOC 2, data residency, required evidence)
3) 30-minute kickoff availability next week (I’m proposing Tue/Wed 10–11am PT)

I’ve looped Priya (Customer Success) and Evelyn (Solutions) who will be our primary leads for onboarding and technical integration. If you prefer different owners on our side, say so and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: redwood_map_template.xlsx (MAP template), sample_eval_checklist.docx

Links: MAP draft (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_EvergreenMAP

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laila Morgan <laila.morgan@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual roadmap kickoff: Evergreen Health evaluation scope & owners

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear outline. Quick responses inline:

- Champion: Sam Cho (me) — I’ll be the day-to-day champion
- Technical lead: Devon Patel (CTO) — copying him in a follow-up; he’ll own integration
- Product/stakeholder: Laila Morgan (PM) — cc’d here

We’d like to try to compress the window to ~45 days if possible — we have an internal timeline tied to a board review in mid-July.

Kickoff availability: Tue 6/10 10–10:30am PT or Wed 6/11 11–11:30am PT — 30 minutes should be fine for introductions and to lock dates.

Procurement/regulatory: we’ll need SOC 2 summary and an outline of data retention and encryption. Our procurement team typically asks for a short questionnaire — I’ll share that once Devon is on thread.

Thanks — Sam

Hi Sam and Devon —

Thanks for the quick reply, Sam. Devon — welcome on the thread. We can absolutely target a 45-day window to align with your board cadence. Proposed next steps:

1) Kickoff: 30m intro meeting to confirm scope, success criteria, data pipeline contacts (proposed Tue 6/10 10:00–10:30am PT)
2) Data ingestion test (7 days) — engineering POC
3) Pilot run (21–28 days)
4) Interim check-in (end of pilot window)
5) Final evaluation + executive summary

I’ve attached a Mutual Milestone Plan (mutual_milestone_plan.xlsx) with tentative dates mapped to the 45-day timeline.

Devon — to make the ingestion test smooth, could you share the person who will own SFTP/API creds and the internal data steward? If procurement requires a PO/contract before any data moves, we can pause the ingestion step and run the pilot on de-identified test data.

Attachments: mutual_milestone_plan.xlsx

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Devon Patel <devon.patel@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Laila Morgan <laila.morgan@evergreenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual roadmap kickoff: Evergreen Health evaluation scope & owners

Thanks Marcus/Sam — looping in procurement and legal for visibility. A few items from our side before kickoff:

- Procurement: we will need SOC 2 Type II summary and the last audit date; please attach SOC evidence (high level)
- Security: summary of encryption-at-rest and in-transit, and a data retention policy (we prefer 90 days for POC)
- Contracting: standard timeline is 2–3 weeks for an MSA + SOW redlines — if you can provide an editable SOW/DocuSign, that helps expedite

I’ve attached a short procurement intake (procurement_checklist.pdf) — procurement will fill and return. If you can share SOC2 summary and a sample SOW by Monday, we’ll be able to keep to the 45-day timeline.
